technical.summary: Mixed short-term bullish momentum (RSI-9, supertrend, hull) offset by bearish stochastic cross, weak trend strength (ADX 10.64), and price below intermediate moving averages; moderate confluence with elevated caution.

fundamental.summary: LUV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 43 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment (21/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no institutional conviction signal.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (305.4), rising dollar, and recent CPI event creates severe headwinds for LUV; 43-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI-9, supertrend, and hull momentum signals combined with extreme fear sentiment (21/100) and price near support (34.39) offer contrarian entry for mean reversion in oversold conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is in crisis (VIX 305.4, inverted yield curve, rising DXY), price is below all intermediate moving averages with weak trend strength (ADX 10.64), stochastic bearish cross confirms momentum failure, and 43-day earnings risk looms with zero fundamental conviction.

decision.entry_rationale: While RSI-9 and supertrend show short-term bullish momentum with price at support, the macro environment is in crisis (VIX 305.4, inverted yield curve, rising DXY) and price remains below all intermediate moving averages with weak trend confirmation (ADX 10.64).
decision.primary_risk: Macro headwinds combined with 43-day earnings event risk and zero fundamental conviction create asymmetric downside; stochastic bearish cross signals momentum failure despite short-term oversold conditions.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical shows mixed signals; fundamental and risk agents strongly bearish; sentiment offers contrarian angle but insufficient to override macro and earnings concerns.
decision.portfolio_note: Already 51 positions in Industrials sector (16% of portfolio); adding LUV increases concentration risk in unfavourable macro environment without offsetting fundamental or institutional conviction.
